paite: TOUPA na Pathian un agam uh nou ahon piak namte TOUPA'N ahihmanthat khopite na luah ua, a-innte ua na ten chiang un;
heading: Kihumbitna Khopite / (Nam 35.9-34; Jos 20.1-9)
english: When Yahweh your God cuts off the nations whose land Yahweh your God gives you, and you succeed them and dwell in their cities and in their houses,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia nou ahon piakna gam ah nou a ding in khopi thum na sep ding uhi.
english: you shall set apart three cities for yourselves in the middle of your land, which Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

paite: Huai khopite zotna ding lampite sial unla, TOUPA'N hon luahsak ding gam seh thum suah un. Huchi in mi that kha kuapeuh huaite ah atailut thei ding uhi.
english: You shall prepare the way, and divide the borders of your land which Yahweh your God causes you to inherit into three parts, that every man slayer may flee there.

paite: Huai a tailutmi that kha bit thei ding hiaite ahi: Mi a-invengte tuma lam a huatna leng nei khol lou a that kha peuhmahte;
english: This is the case of the man slayer who shall flee there and live: Whoever kills his neighbor unintentionally, and didn’t hate him in time past—

paite: a-invengte toh sing phuk dia gamlak a kuan, asing phuk dia aheipi asat a, heipi tang kitol in a-invengte adenlup khakte ahi ding ua hiai khopite lak a khatpeuh ah atai thei ding uh;
english: as when a man goes into the forest with his neighbor to chop wood and his hand swings the ax to cut down the tree, and the head slips from the handle and hits his neighbor so that he dies—he shall flee to one of these cities and live.

paite: sisan phulami in ahehna apai lai a mithat mi pen delh a, lampi asau ziak a delhpha in ava satlum kha ding hi. Tuma lam a huatna na nei khol lou ahih ziak in si tak ahi kei hi.
english: Otherwise, the avenger of blood might pursue the man slayer while hot anger is in his heart and overtake him, because the way is long, and strike him mortally, even though he was not worthy of death, because he didn’t hate him in time past.

paite: Huaiziak in Khopi thum nou a ding in na sep ding uh, chi in thu ka hon pia hi.
english: Therefore I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na pi-le-pute uh kiang a, ana kichiam bang a na pi-le-pute uh piak ana chiam gam ahon piak a;
english: If Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has sworn to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he promised to give to your fathers;

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh it ding leh alampi zui gige ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak tengteng na zuih uleh hiai khopi thumte sim louh in nou a ding in khopi thum dang na behlap nawn ding uhi.
english: and if you keep all this commandment to do it, which I command you today, to love Yahweh your God, and to walk ever in his ways, then you shall add three cities more for yourselves, in addition to these three.

paite: Hiai bel TOUPA'N luah ding a ahon piak na gamsung ua poi khoih lou sisan suah a-om louh a, na tung ua sisan a-omlouhna ding ahi.
english: This is so that innocent blood will not be shed in the middle of your land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, leaving blood guilt on you.

paite: Himahleh mi'n a-invengte ahuat a, atan a, asual a, si khop hial a avuak a, huai khopite lak a khat a ataileh;
english: But if any man hates his neighbor, lies in wait for him, rises up against him, strikes him mortally so that he dies, and he flees into one of these cities;

paite: akho upate un mi sawl uhenla, huai mipa va pi uhenla, hihlup ding in sisan phulami khut ah pekhia uhen.
english: then the elders of his city shall send and bring him there, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

paite: Amah na hehpih ding uh ahi kei a, nou a dia hoih ding in Israel gam a pan poi khoih lou sisan suahna na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: Your eye shall not pity him, but you shall purge the innocent blood from Israel that it may go well with you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un luah dia ahon piak gam ah, ana phuhsa uh na invengte gamgi na suan ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Tang Lai Gamgite
english: You shall not remove your neighbor’s landmark, which they of old time have set, in your inheritance which you shall inherit, in the land that Yahweh your God gives you to possess.

paite: Mi athulimlouhna hiam, akhelhna himhim hiam theihpih khat ahun kei dia; theihpih nih kam hiam, theihpih thum kam hiam a thu hihkip ding ahi.
heading: Theihpihtute Toh Kisai
english: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin that he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall a matter be established.

paite: Mi khatpeuh thil hihkhial a ngoh dia tup gilou nei theihpihmi adinleh,
english: If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,

paite: huai bang a kingohna neite gel TOUPA ma leh huai hun a siampute leh vaihawmte ma ah adingh tuak ding uhi.
english: then both the men, between whom the controversy is, shall stand before Yahweh, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days;

paite: Vaihawmte'n ngenteltak in thu adong ding ua, ngai in, theihpihmi thu theihpih zuau ahih a, a-unau zuau a ngoh ahihleh;
english: and the judges shall make diligent inquisition; and behold, if the witness is a false witness, and has testified falsely against his brother,

paite: a-unau tung a hih atup bangbang amah tung ah na hih ding uh. Huchibang in na lak ua thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: then you shall do to him as he had thought to do to his brother. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Midangte'n aza ding ua, alau ding ua, huchi in tunung chiang in huchibang thil hoih lou mawngmawng na lak uah ahih nawn kei ding uhi.
english: Those who remain shall hear, and fear, and will never again commit any such evil among you.

paite: Na hehpih ding uh ahi kei. Hinna tang in hinna, mit tang in mit, ha tang in ha, khut tang in khut, khe tang in khe ahi ding ahi.
english: Your eyes shall not pity: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
